description_en: Queries the resource usage of an AnalyticDB for MySQL cluster
description_zh: 调用DescribeClusterResourceUsage接口查询集群资源使用情况
name: DescribeClusterResourceUsage

parameters.help_en:
The cluster ID.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/612397.html operation to query the IDs of all AnalyticDB for MySQL clusters within a region
parameters.help_zh:
集群ID。

您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/612397.html接口查看集群ID
parameters.name: db_cluster_id

parameters.help_en: The beginning of the time range to query. Specify the time in the ISO 8601 standard in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format. The time must be in UTC
parameters.help_zh: 查询开始时间，UTC时间，格式：yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mmZ
parameters.name: start_time

parameters.help_en: The end of the time range to query. Specify the time in the ISO 8601 standard in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format. The time must be in UTC
parameters.help_zh: 查询结束时间，UTC时间，格式：yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mmZ
parameters.name: end_time

AcuInfo.description_en: The AnalyticDB compute unit (ACU) usage of the cluster

Name.description_en:
The resource usage metric. Valid values:

`TotalAcuNumber`: the total number of ACUs.
`ReservedAcuNumber`: the number of ACUs for the reserved resources.
`ReservedAcuUsageNumber`: the number of ACUs for the reserved resources that are used
Name.description_zh:
对应指标项取值的状态，取值说明：
`TotalAcuNumber`：总ACU资源数。
`ReservedAcuNumber`：预留资源ACU数。
`ReservedAcuUsageNumber`：已使用的预留资源ACU数

Values.description_en: The values of the metric at specific points in time
Values.description_zh: 对应指标项在各时间点的具体取值

items.description_en: The value of the metric at a specific point in time
items.description_zh: 不同时间点下的性能值详情

EndTime.description_en: The end time of the query. The time follows the ISO 8601 standard in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format. The time is displayed in UTC
EndTime.description_zh: 查询结束时间，UTC时间，格式：yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mmZ

StartTime.description_en: The start time of the query. The time follows the ISO 8601 standard in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format. The time is displayed in UTC
StartTime.description_zh: 查询开始时间，UTC时间，格式：yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mmZ
